nodes.label: T5 Deviation: Evidence Ratio Definition
nodes.rationale: The literal 'fraction of functions with evidence' makes the <0.5 -> run all policy tier unreachable under frozen weights. Using edge confidence keeps the tier reachable.

nodes.label: T5 Deviation: Out-of-order Build
